rows.en:
(I felt like cooking for the first time in ages,
but I'm out of seasonings.
Better buy some fast and head home.)

Huh, who's that over there...
Alto and Ranka?

What's up, you two?
On a date, maybe?
\p, what are you doing here...?

What am I doing here? Shopping, obviously.
So, are you two on a date?
Nice going, Ranka!

Th-this isn't a date!
We just ran into each other and got talking.
rows.notes: Ranka, both genders (flustered; the Japanese slips into polite desu/masu).

rows.en: Right, Alto-kun?

Yeah.
Like I'd ever go on a date with someone like Ranka.
rows.notes: Alto, both genders. 'Ranka nanka' dismissive, kept at full strength.

rows.en: ...You really say harsh stuff sometimes, Alto.
Someone like me, huh...
rows.notes: Ranka, both genders, echoing Alto's 'Ranka nanka'.

rows.en:
Ah, no!
That was just a figure of speech,
it's not like that...!
rows.notes: Alto, male version ('sou iu wake de wa').

rows.en: Then what DID you mean?!

W-well, see, this is...
Hey, \p!

Well, I've got shopping to do...
See you, you two.
Don't you run away!!
(Not my problem~)

(I felt like cooking for the first time in ages,
but I'm out of seasonings!
Better buy some fast and head home.)

Huh, who's that over there...
Saotome-kun and Ranka-chan?

What's up, you two?
Are you on a date, maybe?

What am I doing here? I came shopping.
So, are you two on a date?
Nice going, Ranka-chaan!

...You really say harsh stuff sometimes,
Saotome-kun.

Ah, no!
That was just a figure of speech,
that's not what I meant...!
rows.notes: Alto, female version ('sou iu imi de wa').

rows.en:
Well, I've got shopping to do...
See you, you two.
(Summer break, huh. What should I do with it...)
Hi~, \p.
rows.notes: Sheryl, both genders (no -chan in the Japanese here, so none added); also nml_she_012 and scd_com_620. 'Hi~' as settled.

rows.en: Oh, Sheryl!

Don't go around all dazed just because it's
summer break, geez. Or wait, could it be...?
Running into me went straight to your head?
rows.notes: Sheryl, male. noboseru = get giddy/lightheaded; she teases that meeting her did it.

rows.en:
Well, never mind that.
Tell me how people spend summer here on Frontier.

How we spend summer...
Well, going to the pool or the beach, cooling off
at the library, eating soft serve...
That! That's it! Soft serve!

In this heat, it's bound to taste twice as good!
Glad I asked you. See you!

(Does Sheryl have nothing to do
over summer break...?)
rows.notes: Male. hima = free, with nothing to do.

rows.en: (Summer break, huh. What should I do...)
Oh, Sheryl-san!

Aren't you getting a little carried away just
because it's summer break? You're spoiling
that pretty face of yours.
Oh, um, yes...

Well, never mind that.
Could you tell me how people spend summer
here on Frontier?

How we spend summer...?
Well, going to the pool or the beach, cooling off
at the library, eating soft serve...

(Does Sheryl-san have nothing to do
over summer break...?)
(Sheryl's concert is coming up soon...)

Oh, \p, what's the matter?
Were you thinking about my concert, perhaps?

Well, of course you were. You're doing stunts
at my concert, so you must be under a ton
of pressure until you pull it off...
rows.notes: Sheryl, both genders. The player does the EX-Gear stunt (c15959).

rows.en:
Anyway, be careful not to get in my way.
The star of the show is me, Sheryl Nome!
Well, that's true, but...

(She's like that normally, but once she's on stage...
she really does become the "Galactic Fairy"...)
rows.notes: Male. Galactic Fairy per glossary; quotes kept from the Japanese brackets.

rows.en: (Sheryl-san's concert is coming up soon...)

Oh, \p-chan, what's the matter?
Were you thinking about my concert, perhaps?

Anyway, be careful not to get hurt.
It's a big stage, so let's both enjoy it!
(Doesn't Sheryl-san ever feel any pressure?)
(I wonder what the new planet will be like...)

Oh, \p?
What's with that gloomy face...?

Nothing, I was just wondering what
the new planet will be like.

Who cares what it's like!
Wherever you go, you're still you.
Nothing changes!
That may be true, but...

Then quit it already. Fretting like that
is making ME anxious too!
I see... You're right!

That's right. What matters is who you are now.
Don't forget it.
(Sheryl's really, really positive.)
(I wonder what the new planet will be like...)

Oh, \p-chan?
What's with that gloomy face...?

Oh, nothing. I was just wondering what
the new planet will be like.
That may be true, but...
I see... You're right!
(Sheryl-san's really, really positive.)
